name: Aembit
description: A workload access platform with X.509-SVID and JWT-SVID credential providers. It attests workloads, evaluates access policy, and supplies credentials for the destination service.
scope: The documented credential providers define its SPIFFE support; serving the full Workload API is a separate capability.

name: Cofide Connect
description: A workload identity platform built around SPIRE. It manages attestation policy and trust relationships, delivers SVIDs through the Workload API, and provides application integrations and workload events.

name: Defakto
description: A SPIFFE identity platform for workloads across Kubernetes, virtual machines, and serverless environments. Its documented integrations use SVIDs and trust domains to authenticate to services and exchange credentials with cloud platforms.

name: Google Cloud managed workload identities
description: Google Cloud provisions SPIFFE-based X.509 credentials and trust anchors through Certificate Authority Service for supported Compute Engine and GKE workloads. Applications can use the credentials for mutual TLS.
scope: The documented GKE offering is in Preview. Available features and identity formats depend on the workload environment.

name: Greymatter
description: An application networking platform that integrates SPIRE to provision workload identities. Its service networking layer combines certificate-based mutual authentication with identity-aware traffic and access policies.

name: Idira Secure Workload Access
description: Palo Alto Networks' workload identity offering attests workloads and issues SPIFFE credentials. Its agents provide a local Workload API, with documented paths for secrets access and JWT-SVID credential exchange.

name: Messier 42 Quantum Helix
description: A Kubernetes platform for high-assurance workload identity across namespaces and trust domains. It supports TPM-backed node attestation and delivers X.509-SVIDs through the SPIFFE Workload API. Namespace policies select issuing authorities. Post-quantum profiles include ML-DSA signatures and ML-KEM or hybrid key establishment. QHx Notary binds application requests and responses to workload identity, producing signed records for independent verification. Its protocol-agnostic engine supports middleware integrations for AI and messaging workflows. CABE integration adds policy-controlled access to encrypted objects.

name: Red Hat Zero Trust Workload Identity Manager
description: An OpenShift operator that manages SPIRE components and workload registration. It provides a supported product path for deploying SPIFFE identities and configuring federation in Red Hat environments.
scope: Feature maturity and support depend on the product release and OpenShift version; consult the matching release documentation.

name: StrongDM ID
role: JWT-SVID issuance for workloads and agents
description: An identity service that issues audience-scoped JWT-SVIDs through an authenticated HTTP API and publishes a trust bundle for verification. Its SPIFFE client examples cover Python, Go, and TypeScript.

name: Teleport Workload Identity
description: Teleport issues short-lived X.509-SVIDs and JWT-SVIDs from a cluster's workload identity authority. Its tbot agent can expose the SPIFFE Workload API and deliver credentials to applications and proxies.

name: Anthropic / Claude
description: Exchanges JWT-SVIDs from a configured SPIFFE issuer for Claude API access tokens. Federation rules match workload claims and select a service account, workspace, and OAuth scope.

name: OpenAI
description: Exchanges JWT-SVIDs from a configured SPIFFE issuer for OpenAI API access tokens. Claim mappings select a project service account and can narrow its API permissions.

name: Riptides
role: SVID issuance and Linux connection integration
description: Issues X.509-SVIDs with SPIFFE IDs in URI SANs and JWT-SVIDs with SPIFFE IDs as subjects. A node daemon matches process selectors; a Linux kernel module generates X.509 private keys and requests certificates through the daemon and control plane. The module uses those credentials for transparent mutual TLS and applies connection policy.
